svg.title: A year of contributions, a whale in motion
svg.desc: The contribution calendar gathers into a top-down text blue whale. Its head dives first, its flukes lift and follow under water, then its nose surfaces before the body returns to the calendar. Motion is baked from dsh-ascii-whales 949c19afacedd31cd0101fb4e2501eadb91aa485. 885 contributions in the last year.
